name: Emirati Chicken Harees Soup

components.name: Chicken Harees

ingredients.name: Whole wheat grains, dry before soaking

steps: Cover dry wheat with plenty of water and soak in the fridge overnight; discard soaking water before cooking.
Place chicken and 1 litre stock in a deep pot, simmer about 20 to 30 minutes until cooked; lift chicken out and check meat reaches 74°C.
Add soaked drained wheat to the chicken stock, cover and simmer gently for approximately 3 hours, stirring occasionally and adding measured additional water only if needed.
Remove bones and skin from chicken; shred edible meat and set aside.
Blend or mash softened wheat until thick and creamy; fold chicken through or serve it on top.

components.name: Caramelised Onion Topping
steps: Meanwhile slowly caramelise the 120 g onion in 15 ml oil until golden. Portion over harees; adjust texture with broth when reheating.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Source servings 4–6, fixed at higher number 6. Soak wheat overnight. Onion garnish is a quantified UNHANGRY addition. Slow-cooker alternative requires equipment-specific testing.
Storing & reheating: Freeze blended wheat base and shredded chicken in measured portions; loosen with stock after thawing.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
